task1: well-formed tubular and complex glandular architectures, infiltrative tumor margins extending into adjacent tissue, and a prominent desmoplastic stroma containing areas of luminal necrotic debris.
task2: moderately differentiated tubular structures, irregular infiltrative growth patterns into the surrounding stroma, and a variable fibroblastic desmoplastic reaction without extensive glandular crowding.
task3: classical tubular adenocarcinoma patterns, complex invading glandular structures, widespread luminal dirty necrosis, and an absence of significant peritumoral lymphoid aggregates or follicles.

task1: prominent mucinous differentiation characterized by large extracellular mucin pools, serrated or distorted glandular growth patterns, and frequent expansile or pushing tumor margins.
task2: dense, irregularly shaped, and crowded glandular regions, complex cribriform architectural patterns, and notable intraluminal dirty necrosis surrounded by an active desmoplastic stroma.
task3: solid or medullary tumor growth patterns lacking well-defined glands, distinct pushing tumor margins, and a dense peritumoral Crohn's-like lymphoid reaction featuring conspicuous lymphoid follicles.

task1: pseudostratified columnar tumor cells with elongated hyperchromatic nuclei, distinct cell borders, preserved partial cellular polarity, and prominent intraluminal granular necrotic debris (dirty necrosis).
task2: an atypical glandular lining with pseudostratified hyperchromatic nuclei, relatively preserved cellular polarity, distinct cellular margins, and scattered mitotic figures.
task3: densely packed malignant glands, pleomorphic tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, and a notable lack of prominent intraepithelial lymphocytes.

task1: atypical epithelial cells floating in abundant extracellular mucin, vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli, loss of regular glandular architecture, and the focal presence of signet-ring cell morphology.
task2: disorganized epithelial cells with loss of nuclear polarity, marked apical mucin depletion, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei, and complex cribriform micro-architectures lacking intervening stroma.
task3: poorly differentiated tumor cells forming solid sheets, large vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli, and a conspicuously high density of intraepithelial tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs).
